items.excerpt: SoundBoost brings AI mixing and mastering driven by natural-language text prompts, plus a free stem splitter and what it bills as ethically trained models, to a claimed 130,000-plus musicians — letting producers dial in a master by describing the sound they want.
Vochlea's DubBox turns beatboxing and vocal percussion into drum loops in real time, training on a user's own voice so a hummed or beatboxed idea instantly triggers sample-based drum patterns.

Google's Flow Music Spaces gains an all-in-one update — folding song generation and editing, stem splitting, lyric writing, and image/video creation into one Lyria 3 Pro-powered AI workspace, pushing it toward a Suno/Udio-style full production suite.
